guide.diagram.reach.note: Ngisho noma kungu-“#1 enkundleni” okufanayo, isikolo sisonke sihluka ngobukhulu bokufinyelela.
guide.diagram.trust.aria: Umdwebo wesici sokwethenjelwa: idatha elinganisiwe iphindaphindwa ngo-1.00 kuya ku-1.06 kuye ngesibalo sokukala, amamethrikhi alinganiselwe ngo-0.78 kuya ku-0.80
guide.example.body: U-#1 wenkundla ngayinye uhlala eduze nephesentayili lokuduma elingu-100. Ngephesentayili kuphela bonke bangalingana, ngakho umsebenzi wenkundla encane onamamethrikhi amakhulu alinganiselwe ungathatha ngephutha u-#1 jikelele. Ukusebenzisa isisindo sokufinyelela nesici sokwethenjelwa njengeziphindaphindi kushintsha indaba. Izinombolo ezingezansi ziqhathanisa kuphela ingxenye eyinhloko yesikolo sokuduma (popComp): yomibili imisebenzi ishicilelwa enkundleni eyodwa (ibhonasi yezinkundla eziningi 1.00), futhi izici zokwethenjelwa ziyizibonelo zamanani angaphakathi kobubanzi. Isikolo sangempela sokuduma sengeza ukulungiswa kokukala futhi siphindaphindwe ngobusha.
guide.example.caption: Ubude bebha bulingana nengxenye yokuduma (popComp), ngokusekelwe ku-105
guide.example.note: Ngisho noma kungu-“#1 enkundleni” okufanayo, ingxenye yokuduma ihluka ngokuphindwe kabili nangaphezulu. Izinkundla ezincane azinakwa — zikhuphuka ngokusemthethweni kwamanye ama-eksisi afana nohlobo namagugu afihliwe.
guide.example.title: Isibonelo: kungani u-#1 jikelele ungewona umsebenzi wenkundla encane kakhulu
guide.honesty.mid1: . Njengoba i-Naver yenze isibalo sayo sokubukwa nesithakazelo saba yimfihlo, amanye amamethrikhi asekelayo afana nokubukwa nezibalo zesithakazelo aboniswa njenge-
guide.honesty.mid2: . Okufanayo kusebenza kwezinye izilinganiso, ukubukwa, namazinga okuqeda kwezinye izinkundla. Izilinganiso zihlala zimakwe ngokucacile nge-
guide.honesty.mid4: engenhla nayo inciphisa ithonya lazo ezilinganisweni. Asilokothi sikhuphule amanani noma izibalo zokubukwa.
guide.honesty.title: Asilokothi sixube idatha elinganisiwe nezilinganiso
guide.how.heading: Izindlela ezine ezingemuva kokulinganisa
guide.how.note: I-eksisi ngayinye iyinhlanganisela yalezi ezine. Bona “Buka ifomula” esinyathelweni ngasinye ukuze uthole ukubala okuqondile.
guide.lede: Akukho ukulinganisa kwe-ToonStudio okukhethwa ngesandla. Ukulinganisa kubalwa kuphela kusuka kufomula eshicilelwe, futhi leyo fomula ibhalwe kuleli khasi — ngoba kufanele ukwazi ukuziqinisekisela ukuthi kungani umsebenzi uhlala lapho ukhona.
guide.pillar.bayes.body: Yikuphi okufanele ukwethembe: u-5.0 ovela ezilinganisweni ezingu-3, noma u-4.6 ovela kwezingu-10,000? Uma izilinganiso zimbalwa, isikolo sidonselwa kakhulu esilinganisweni sisonke; njengoba izilinganiso zinqwabelana, sisondela esikolweni sangempela somsebenzi.
guide.pillar.bayes.formula: bayes = (C×m + isilinganiso esimaphakathi×isibalo sokukala) / (m + isibalo sokukala) — C·m isuselwa ekusatshalalisweni kwekhathalogi
guide.pillar.bayes.title: Ukukala kwe-Bayesian
guide.pillar.percentile.body: Izibalo zokubukwa zisebenzisa amayunithi ahlukene kuyo yonke inkundla, ngakho ukuqhathanisa okuqondile akulungile. Siqala silinganise ukuduma ngaphakathi kwenkundla ngayinye, bese senza abaphezulu kakhulu kuphela bagqame.
guide.pillar.percentile.formula: popComp = 100 × exp((iphesentayili−100)/2.5) × isisindo sokufinyelela × isici sokwethenjelwa × ibhonasi yezinkundla eziningi (1.00–1.06) — isikolo sokuduma = (popComp + ukulungiswa kokukala) × ubusha
guide.pillar.percentile.title: Iphesentayili lokuduma
guide.pillar.reach.body: Ngisho noma kungu-“#1 enkundleni” okufanayo, ukufinyelela kwangempela (ubukhulu bethrafikhi) kuyahluka. Ukuphindaphinda ngobukhulu benkundla kwenza igebe phakathi kwezinkundla ezinkulu nezincane licace.
guide.pillar.reach.formula: isisindo sokufinyelela = esiphezulu phakathi kwezinkundla umsebenzi oshicilelwa kuzo ngochungechunge
guide.pillar.reach.title: Isisindo sokufinyelela
guide.pillar.trust.body: Amanani esiwaqoqe ngempela abalwa ngokuzethemba; amanani agcwaliswe ngokulinganisa abalwa kancane ngaphansi. Lesi yisivikelo esigcina amamethrikhi alinganiselwe ekukhuphuleni imisebenzi elinganisiwe iphume ku-#1.
guide.pillar.trust.title: Isici sokwethenjelwa
guide.reach.desc: Sisebenzisa inani elikhulu kakhulu phakathi kwezinkundla umsebenzi oshicilelwa kuzo ngochungechunge. Liphindaphindwa ezikolweni zokuduma nezithrendayo.
